messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error when deploying app
parts:
Hi Hwanwoo,
It sounds like the application you are trying to deploy is trying to use the old authentication mechanism.  You need to remove that mechanism from your application to be able to deploy.
You are correct that we decided to put the authentication capabilities in the paid plan.   

On Fri, Jul 10, 2015 at 6:14 PM, Hwanwoo Kim <mol...@umich.edu> wrote:
I am trying to deploy shiny app.

I have successfully done steps till deployApp() command, but when I use deployApp() command, I get errors saying

Unhandled Exception: Child Task 53358935 failed: Error building image: This application utilizes scrypt authentication which is no longer supported. For instructions on how to migrate to the new auth system, please visit http://bit.ly/16LhDuO.

I went to this website, and tried to change my applet to private setting, but I can never save it as a private setting. 
Is this only available for those who paid? And I have no idea what the step 2 and 4 are about. Can anyone give more explanations on it?

I am using mac OS X Yosemite 10.10.3

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error when deploying app
parts:
Hwanwoo,
I am sorry we seem to be talking past each other.  If you want to have a private application, you will have to go to the standard paid plan.  We have NO private applications in the free plan.

It sounds like what you are looking for is a private application on our free plan, which we don't support now that we are out of the beta period. 

If you don't mind your application being public, you can skip the first step in the instructions, and simply make the changes that are outlined and you can deploy again.  This will allow you to stay on a free plan and to get access to your application once again.

-Tareef





On Sun, Jul 12, 2015 at 1:27 PM, Hwanwoo Kim <mol...@umich.edu> wrote:
What I am saying is, on the link you provided and Rstudio provided, it says 

  1. Set the Application Visibility setting to Private in the Users tab for that application and click Save Settings. This will restart the application and apply the new setting. Note, once you do this, none of the existing users will be able to authenticate.
In other words, I need to make my applet private. So I am asking, is it impossible to migrate for free? It is quite ridiculous, if so.

Hope this helps
